entries.en: `/resume` on large sessions is significantly faster (up to 67% on 40MB+ sessions) and handles sessions with many dead-fork entries more efficiently
entries.zh: 大型会话的 `/resume` 明显更快（40MB 以上的会话最多快 67%），并且能更高效地处理包含大量失效分叉记录的会话

entries.en: Faster MCP startup when multiple stdio servers are configured; `resources/templates/list` is now deferred to first `@`-mention
entries.zh: 配置多个 stdio 服务器时 MCP 启动速度更快； `resources/templates/list` 现在推迟到第一个 `@` 提及

entries.en: Smoother fullscreen scrolling in VS Code, Cursor, and Windsurf terminals — `/terminal-setup` now configures the editor's scroll sensitivity
entries.zh: VS Code、Cursor 和 Windsurf 终端中全屏滚动更顺滑；`/terminal-setup` 现在会配置编辑器的滚动灵敏度

entries.en: Thinking spinner now shows progress inline ("still thinking", "thinking more", "almost done thinking"), replacing the separate hint row
entries.zh: 思考时的加载动画现在在行内显示进度（"still thinking"、"thinking more"、"almost done thinking"），取代了单独的提示行

entries.en: `/config` search now matches option values (e.g. searching "vim" finds the Editor mode setting)
entries.zh: `/config` 搜索现在会匹配选项的值（例如搜索 "vim" 可找到 Editor mode 设置）

entries.en: `/doctor` can now be opened while Claude is responding, without waiting for the current turn to finish
entries.zh: Claude 回复时也可以打开 `/doctor`，无需等待当前轮次结束

entries.en: `/reload-plugins` and background plugin auto-update now auto-install missing plugin dependencies from marketplaces you've already added
entries.zh: `/reload-plugins` 和后台插件自动更新，现在会从你已添加的市场中自动安装缺失的插件依赖

entries.en: Bash tool now surfaces a hint when `gh` commands hit GitHub's API rate limit, so agents can back off instead of retrying
entries.zh: 现在，当`gh`命令达到 GitHub 的 API 速率限制时，Bash 工具会显示提示，因此代理可以后退而不是重试

entries.en: Slash command menu now shows "No commands match" when your filter has zero results, instead of disappearing
entries.zh: 筛选结果为零时，斜杠命令菜单显示 "No commands match"，而不再直接消失

entries.en: Claude Code and installer now use `https://downloads.claude.ai/claude-code-releases` instead of `https://storage.googleapis.com/claude-code-dist-86c565f3-f756-42ad-8dfa-d59b1c096819/claude-code-releases`
entries.zh: Claude Code 和安装程序现在使用`https://downloads.claude.ai/claude-code-releases`，而不是`https://storage.googleapis.com/claude-code-dist-86c565f3-f756-42ad-8dfa-d59b1c096819/claude-code-releases`

entries.en: The Usage tab in Settings now shows your 5-hour and weekly usage immediately and no longer fails when the usage endpoint is rate-limited
entries.zh: 设置中的 Usage 标签页现在会立即显示 5 小时和每周用量，且在用量接口被限流时不再报错

entries.en: Agent frontmatter `hooks:` now fire when running as a main-thread agent via `--agent`
entries.zh: 现在，通过`--agent`作为主线程代理运行时，代理 frontmatter`hooks:`会触发

entries.en: Security: sandbox auto-allow no longer bypasses the dangerous-path safety check for `rm`/`rmdir` targeting `/`, `$HOME`, or other critical system directories
entries.zh: 安全：沙箱自动允许不再绕过对 `rm`/`rmdir` 删除 `/`、`$HOME` 或其他关键系统目录的危险路径检查

entries.en: Fixed Devanagari and other Indic scripts rendering with broken column alignment in the terminal UI
entries.zh: 修复了天城文和其他印度文脚本在终端 UI 中呈现的列对齐方式损坏的问题

entries.en: Fixed Ctrl+- not triggering undo in terminals using the Kitty keyboard protocol (iTerm2, Ghostty, kitty, WezTerm, Windows Terminal)
entries.zh: 修复了 Ctrl+- 在使用 Kitty 键盘协议的终端（iTerm2、Ghostty、kitty、WezTerm、Windows 终端）中不触发撤消的问题

entries.en: Fixed Cmd+Left/Right not jumping to line start/end in terminals that use the Kitty keyboard protocol (Warp fullscreen, kitty, Ghostty, WezTerm)
entries.zh: 修复了使用 Kitty 键盘协议（Warp 全屏、kitty、Ghostty、WezTerm）的终端中 Cmd+Left/Right 不跳转到行开始/结束的问题

entries.en: Fixed Ctrl+Z hanging the terminal when Claude Code is launched via a wrapper process (e.g. `npx`, `bun run`)
entries.zh: 修复了当通过包装进程启动 Claude Code 时 Ctrl+Z 挂起终端的问题（例如`npx`、`bun run`）

entries.en: Fixed scrollback duplication in inline mode where resizing the terminal or large output bursts would repeat earlier conversation history
entries.zh: 修复了内联模式下的回滚重复问题，其中调整终端大小或大输出突发会重复早期的对话历史记录

entries.en: Fixed modal search dialogs overflowing the screen at short terminal heights, hiding the search box and keyboard hints
entries.zh: 修复了模式搜索对话框在终端高度较短时溢出屏幕、隐藏搜索框和键盘提示的问题

entries.en: Fixed scattered blank cells and disappearing composer chrome in the VS Code integrated terminal during scrolling
entries.zh: 修复了滚动期间 VS Code 集成终端中分散的空白单元格和消失的 Composer chrome

entries.en: Fixed an intermittent API 400 error related to cache control TTL ordering that could occur when a parallel request completed during request setup
entries.zh: 修复了与缓存控制 TTL 排序相关的间歇性 API 400 错误，该错误可能在请求设置期间完成并行请求时发生

entries.en: Fixed `/branch` rejecting conversations with transcripts larger than 50MB
entries.zh: 修复了`/branch`拒绝对话文本大于 50MB 的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/resume` silently showing an empty conversation on large session files instead of reporting the load error
entries.zh: 修复了`/resume`在大型会话文件上静默显示空对话而不是报告加载错误的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/plugin` Installed tab showing the same item twice when it appears under Needs attention or Favorites
entries.zh: 修复了`/plugin`已安装选项卡在同一项目出现在“需要注意”或“收藏夹”下时显示两次的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/update` and `/tui` not working after entering a worktree mid-session
entries.zh: 修复了`/update`和`/tui`在进入工作树中间会话后不起作用的问题
